instruction.name: armmtflag
instruction.description: Write selected ARM flags in ARMFLAGS from the corresponding bit positions in rd, as determined by mask. Only ARMFLAGS is modified.

operands.name: rd
operands.description: source bits for the selected flags

operands.name: mask
operands.description: flag-selection mask (0xf selects N, Z, C, V)

experiments.name: extra armmfflag calibration
experiments.notes: Calibration experiment (not used for the reported latency).

latencies.notes: 1 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 10000, iters 1000. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: armmtflag $r4, 0xf; armmtflag $r5, 0xf; armmtflag $r6, 0xf; armmtflag $r7, 0xf; armmtflag $r8, 0xf; armmtflag $r9, 0xf; armmtflag $r10, 0xf; armmtflag $r11, 0xf
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; armmtflag $r0, 0xf
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 10000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; armmtflag $r0, 0xf' --asm 'armmtflag $r4, 0xf; armmtflag $r5, 0xf; armmtflag $r6, 0xf; armmtflag $r7, 0xf; armmtflag $r8, 0xf; armmtflag $r9, 0xf; armmtflag $r10, 0xf; armmtflag $r11, 0xf'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
